gen-dafont-origami-fs-synonym: Synonym reads as dependable ink with generously opened curves, moderate in height and quietly clean, while Origami towers over it with its poured-lead lowercase. Pages stay easy going.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-bree-serif: Origami looks brushed in one stroke at constant width. Its lowercase mass is like poured lead type, and Bree Serif, a refined text serif with outsized, low proportions, gives that weight a literary counterweight.
gen-dafont-origami-outfit: Outfit bends its curves like cable, stopping well before they close, while Origami stands high with a sign-painter's single-stroke brush look. Origami is at its best big and brief.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-fs-synonym: Outrun Future traces wide-spaced letters in an outline you could follow with a finger. Synonym follows underneath in dependable, moderate-height sans with generous curve openings, so the synthwave swagger gets a steady footing.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-sora: Synthwave, wide-set and bold. Outrun Future commands with its constant-width outline and large x-height, and Sora takes over for the details, keeping its sans-serif curves precise and its c and s widely parted.
gen-dafont-over-there-fs-alpino: Alpino is a cozy, casual sans-serif whose body is so high that its ascenders look short. And Over There, drawn like a fixed-width nib, adds a vintage-military command.
gen-dafont-over-there-fs-familjen-grotes: Over There looks drawn by a fixed-width nib, with wirelike strokes and generous white space between glyphs. Familjen Grotesk answers in a lively plain sans, its bowls left open on one side, which gives the pair a crisp, commanding contrast.
gen-dafont-over-there-fs-quicksand: Wirelike strokes from a fixed-width nib give Over There its vintage-military look. Over There commands at a distance, while Quicksand, with bulb-round bowls and terminals clear of the stem, keeps a paragraph approachable.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-habibi: Habibi is a traditional, editorial text serif with a clear channel leading into every round. And Over There, in one weight from rounds to stems, keeps the pair crisp, commanding, and vintage.
